# 3.1.2 Language of Parts (Level AA)

- Principle: 3 Understandable
- Guideline: 3.1 Readable
- Level: AA
- Versions: 2.0, 2.1, 2.2
- Understanding: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/language-of-parts.html
- Specification: https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#language-of-parts

## Normative text

The [human language](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#dfn-human-language-s) of each passage or phrase in the content can be [programmatically determined](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#dfn-programmatically-determinable) except for proper names, technical terms, words of indeterminate language, and words or phrases that have become part of the vernacular of the immediately surrounding [text](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#dfn-text).

## Sufficient techniques

- H58: Using language attributes to identify changes in the human language
- PDF19: Specifying the language for a passage or phrase with the Lang entry in PDF documents
